GridData.title: GridData
GridData.description: Represents the matrix cell values and secondary table values for a specific context (user global or client).

cells.description: A mapping of cell indices (1-100) to their numerical values.

secondaryCells.description: A mapping of A/B cell keys (e.g., 'A1', 'B5') to their numerical values.

SavedSheet.title: SavedSheet
SavedSheet.description: A snapshot of the grid data with a specific name.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: A client with their own matrix and financial terms.

claim.description: Flat amount subtracted from balance after commission.

claimRate.description: Multiplier used to calculate claim based on a reference box.

/grids/{userId}/dailySheets/{dateId}.description: Stores the dated matrix and side table data for the user's global dashboard.

/grids/{userId}/savedSheets/{sheetId}.description: Individual snapshots of grid data saved by the user.

/grids/{userId}/clients/{clientId}/daily.description: Stores the dated matrix and side table data for a specific client.
